test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the given words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Mysore

2. India

3. Karnataka

4. Asia

5. World
solution:
The correct option that indicates the arrangement of the given words in a logical and meaningful order is:

 
• Asia is one of the seven continents of the World.
 
• India is a country in the continent of Asia.
 
• Karnataka is a state in the country India.
